review_evidence: README identifies risc0-lean4 as a formal Lean model of the RISC Zero zkVM. The 57 primary formal files were inventoried: 53 own declarations, with about 599 definitions/theorems/structures spanning ELF parsing, RV32IM semantics, SHA-256, Merkle verification, Baby Bear arithmetic, NTT, FRI, arithmetic circuits and zkVM verification.

Soundness/ProofSystem.lean defines hash-query adversaries, probability-mass interfaces and a verifier-soundness predicate; RiscV/Instr/Types.lean and Zkvm/Algebra/BabyBear.lean are declaration-dense semantic modules and remain searchable.
lakefile.lean was inspected completely and only declares package/library/executable targets and dependencies.

rules.content_invariant: The complete file contains only Lake DSL package, dependency, library and executable target declarations; all ELF/RISC-V/hash/zkVM/soundness definitions remain in separately retained modules.
evidence: Complete lakefile.lean inspected; formal semantics and soundness modules are separately retained.
rules.rationale: lakefile.lean is Lake package/target/dependency configuration, not zkVM/RISC-V formal semantics.

summary: Retain the RISC Zero executable semantics and soundness/formal-verification development; exclude only the exact Lake build file.
